name: Aapravasi Ghat
description: Aapravasi Ghat is a small waterfront site in Port Louis, Mauritius, where the British landed almost half a million indentured labourers from India between 1834 and 1920. Many went on to the island's sugar plantations, while others were sent on to places such as Réunion, Australia and the Caribbean. Today you can walk among the surviving stone buildings of this immigration depot, where one of history's great migrations began.
